text:
emma: dropping a tiny joy pic 60d meet Barley, my rescue hedgehog, caught mid-coffee-table snooze. he fell into a sun puddle and now claims the coaster as territory https://i.imgur.com/fakeBarley1.jpg
rafael: that little quill halo is everything. honorary office mascot? yes pls
priya: does he require a tiny blanket? he looks like a delighted porcupine croissant 
chandler: i will volunteer to be official coaster guard. also: does he judge mugs?
emma: @chandler only ceramic mugs. travel tumblers are beneath his dignity. he accepts snuffles and occasional mealworm bribes
devbot: Upload finished: barley_coffee_table_snooze_01.jpg (1.9 MB)
rafael: caption contest: "steeped in sunlight" or "espresso naps"
priya: vote: "stolen the sun, left crumbs"
emma: adding a tiny slo-mo of the stretch in the next message
chandler: offering to knit a tiny duvet. what color aligns with hedgehog aesthetics? earth tones? mustard?
emma: mustard or olive. also he prefers acoustic background noise (chill indie) while snoozing
priya: can we start a weekly "Barley Break" for 2 minutes of hedgehog zen? I vote yes
rafael: yes. adding to calendar: "Barley Break - 14:30 local" (optional meditation)
devbot: Message pinned by emma: barley_coffee_table_snooze_01.jpg
emma: thanks team 60a he accepts boops by appointment only, and will trade a tiny paw handshake for a mealworm.
